item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","summary":"Four [P1] findings remain: two previously outstanding issues are unchanged, ledger validation is still not fully fail-closed, and the required authoritative golden corpus remains incomplete.","recommendations":[{"severity":"important","location":"Task 6, Step 3 — gauntlet_review/state.py::doc_state_dir and state-file reads","issue":"[P1] The previously reported path-confinement defect remains unchanged. Resolving `root` follows a symlinked `docs/superpowers/reviews` and then treats its external target as trusted; `exists()`, `read_text()`, and ledger reads also follow symlinked files. Repository-controlled links can therefore redirect host-side reads and directory creation outside the repository.","suggestion":"Anchor confinement to the resolved repository root, reject symlinked path components and non-regular state files, and use bounded descriptor-relative/no-follow reads with revalidation to avoid traversal and TOCTOU races."},{"severity":"important","location":"Task 1, Step 3 — gauntlet_review/jcs.py::_escape_string and _utf16_key","issue":"[P1] The previously reported RFC 8785 input-validation defect remains unchanged. Lone surrogates in values are emitted into a string that `canonical_bytes()` cannot UTF-8 encode; lone surrogates in keys raise incidental `UnicodeEncodeError`; and non-string dictionary keys raise incidental attribute/encoding errors instead of the promised type error.","suggestion":"Validate all keys and string values for Unicode scalar validity, reject lone surrogates deterministically, explicitly reject non-string dictionary keys, and add recursive tests for invalid keys and nested values."},{"severity":"important","location":"Task 6, Step 3 — gauntlet_review/state.py::validate_carryover_ledger","issue":"[P1] Ledger validation is still not fully fail-closed. `ledger.get(\"entries\")` followed by `None -> []` accepts a missing or null required array whenever no prior recommendations are derived. Moreover, an array or object supplied as `status` reaches `status not in _VALID_STATUS` and raises an uncaught `TypeError` instead of returning an invalid `LedgerResult`. Thus the earlier exact-type recommendation was only partially addressed.","suggestion":"Require an explicitly present list-valued `entries` field, validate `status` as a string before set membership, validate every optional field's permitted type, and add tests for missing/null entries and list/object statuses."},{"severity":"important","location":"Tasks 1–3 and 6 — serialization, normalization, recommendation-id, and state tests","issue":"[P1] The authoritative golden corpus required by the spec is still absent. The tests remain isolated inline assertions; UTF-16 ordering uses only ASCII, the ID constants are expressly captured from the PowerShell implementation despite the spec requiring authoritative vectors not sourced from the other implementation, and there are no corpus cases for lone surrogates, full size boundaries, or carry-over transitions.","suggestion":"Add an independently approved fixture corpus with authoritative JCS bytes and IDs covering BMP-versus-supplementary UTF-16 ordering, multibyte and escaped Unicode, lone surrogates, exact and over-limit size boundaries, numeric boundaries, malformed and normalized verdicts, severity downgrade, and carry-over transitions."}]}
